[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing hiking boots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Fit: Ensure a comfortable, snug fit with enough room for toes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Waterproofing: Look for boots with a waterproof membrane, such as Gore-Tex or eVent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Ankle support: Mid-cut or high-cut boots offer better ankle support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Traction: Look for boots with a rugged, lugged outsole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Weight: Lighter boots can make hiking more comfortable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminder to break in boots before the trip to prevent blisters.
